pros: Successfully centralizes project information and tasks in one place.
Offers a wide range of features and customization options.
Helpful for organizing and overseeing diverse small tasks.
cons: Initial setup and understanding the platform's logic can be complex.
The extensive features can feel overwhelming for a new user.
The interface can be cluttered, especially with AI features enabled by default.
